name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd
about: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL), a part of the Mahindra Group,is a NBFC primarily engaged in the business of financing purchase of new and pre-owned auto and utility vehicles, tractors, cars, commercial vehicles, construction equipment and SME Financing. [1]
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 37.4%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.1% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment 16 Nov - Allotted 87,600 NCDs worth Rs. 876 crore at 8.45% on 16 November 2026.

Intimation For Transfer Of Equity Shares Of The Company From Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited Employees' Stock Option Trust To Eligible Person Pursuant To Exercise Of Vested Stock Options. 12 Nov - On 12 Nov 2026, ESOP Trust transferred 2,53,076 shares to eligible employees.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Issue of Securities 11 Nov - Approved private placement of secured NCDs up to Rs 2,000 crore at 8.45%.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 10 Nov
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Credit Rating 6 Nov - CRISIL, CARE and India Ratings reaffirmed M&M Financial’s ratings across multiple debt instruments on 5-6 Nov 2026.
